_meta.name: CNT Compositional Tensor Train — AI Build Instruction
_meta.purpose: Self-contained instruction set for any AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, an open-source model, an in-house agent) to construct a deterministic CNT analysis pipeline for any compositional dataset. Following this instruction, an AI takes a raw CSV/XLSX, builds the pre-parser, runs the engine, picks the right output suite, renders it, self-verifies against the determinism gate, and returns a journalled, hash-chained result.
_meta.principle: The instrument reads. The expert decides. The hashes carry the receipts. CCTT lets an AI play the role of a careful first-time practitioner, with the hashes verifying the result.

doctrine.name: Output Doctrine
doctrine.rule: Integer orders only. Trajectory aggregates round UP to next order.

determinism_gate.criterion: diagnostics.content_sha256 in regenerated JSON must equal INDEX.experiments[<id>].content_sha256

engine_io_contract._description: Exact CLI + JSON shape the AI must produce/consume. Verified live on 2026-05-06 against engine 2.0.4.

input_csv_shape.row_0: header — first column is the label, remaining D columns are carrier names
input_csv_shape.row_1_to_T: T rows of (label, x_1, x_2, ..., x_D) where x_j > 0 and sum(x_j) > 0
constraints: All carrier values strictly positive — apply imputation BEFORE the adapter writes the CSV
Sum-to-constant is enforced by the engine (re-closes if needed); adapter SHOULD pre-close to 1.0
T >= 2 minimum; T >= 3 for Stage 2; T >= 5 recommended for Stage 3

engine_cli.temporal_flag: Add --temporal when the labels carry a time meaning (years, dates, sequence index).
engine_cli.caveat: Add --ordering-caveat 'free-form note' to record any non-default rationale in the JSON metadata.

key_fields_to_extract.metadata.engine_config: the active overrides; record into JOURNAL
key_fields_to_extract.input.source_file_sha256: byte-hash of the input CSV — must match the user-provided file
key_fields_to_extract.input.closed_data_sha256: post-closure hash of the (T,D) numerical matrix
key_fields_to_extract.diagnostics.content_sha256: THE GATE — this is what the determinism corpus pins against

decision_data_shape_diagnostics._description: Phase 1 — what the AI computes from the raw input before touching anything else.
compute: T (record count after dropping junk rows)
D (carrier count after dropping non-numeric / metadata columns)
label_column_kind (one of: time-index, named-categories, ordered-numeric, free-text)
candidate_carriers (column names that look like carriers: not unit, source, year, country, etc.)

decision_table.action: REQUIRE adapter to apply zero-replacement (multiplicative imputation, see Volume I §4.2) BEFORE writing the engine CSV. Do not run the engine on raw zeros.
STOP. Surface the offending rows to the user. Do not guess.

phase_1_diagnose_data.goal: Understand what the user gave you. No engine calls yet.
actions: Read first 20 rows + last 5 rows; note column count, dtype mix.
Identify label column (usually the first non-numeric column).
Identify candidate carrier columns (numeric, no metadata suffix).
Compute proposed (T, D, is_temporal, ordering_method) and a one-paragraph plain-English description of what the dataset is.
outputs: dataset_diagnosis.json — the AI's working memory for phases 2-7
stop_conditions: Cannot identify a label column — ASK USER.
Mixed dtypes inside a 'carrier' column — ASK USER for column intent.
Fewer than 2 viable rows after junk-row removal — STOP.

phase_2_select_or_generate_adapter.goal: Convert the raw file into the canonical engine-input CSV (label + D carriers, all positive, all closed).

branch_a_match_existing.criteria: If the dataset signature (column names, row count band, domain) matches a built-in adapter in HCI-CNT/adapters/, use it directly.

match_signatures.ember_*: CSV columns include: Year + (Bioenergy, Coal, Gas, Hydro, Nuclear, Other Fossil, Solar, Wind)
match_signatures.geochem_*: CSV columns are oxide names (SiO2, Al2O3, FeO, MgO, ...) with regional/age labels
match_signatures.fao_irrigation_methods: CSV columns are irrigation method names with country labels
match_signatures.markham_budget: CSV with department names + budget columns
match_signatures.iiasa_ngfs: CSV with NGFS sector emissions schema
match_signatures.esa_planck_cosmic: CSV with cosmic energy budget components + redshift
match_signatures.chemixhub_oxide: CSV with HOIP-7 oxide composition schema

branch_b_generate_new.criteria: If no built-in matches, generate a new adapter following the disclosure template.

must_contain_sections: # Source disclosure — provenance, URL/citation, retrieval date, original SHA
# Carrier mapping — which raw column → which carrier (with units)
# Transformation log — closure, imputation, aggregation, dropped rows
# Output: writes <name>_input.csv with shape (T, label + D)
# Output: writes <name>_disclosure.json with the same data in machine form
ten_minute_skeleton: 1. Load raw file (handle CSV/XLSX with explicit sheet name).
2. Drop / filter rows per source-specific rules; log counts.
3. Map columns: keep only the D carrier columns + 1 label column.
4. Impute zeros using multiplicative replacement (Aitchison) — disclose multiplier.
5. Close each row to sum=1 (or leave to engine and disclose).
7. Write <name>_disclosure.json with all of the above as fields.
8. Print SHA-256 of <name>_input.csv on stdout for the AI to record.

phase_2_select_or_generate_adapter.user_confirmation_gate: BEFORE running the engine, the AI MUST echo back to the user: (a) the proposed carrier list, (b) the label-column interpretation, (c) the (T, D, is_temporal, ordering_method) tuple. Wait for user confirmation. Do not silently proceed past this gate.

actions: Run; capture stdout (engine prints content_sha256 + signature on the last lines).
Verify the JSON parses and has all 7 top-level keys: metadata, input, tensor, stages, bridges, depth, diagnostics.

Extract: metadata.engine_version, metadata.schema_version, input.source_file_sha256, input.closed_data_sha256, diagnostics.content_sha256, diagnostics.higgins_extensions.IR_class, diagnostics.higgins_extensions.amplitude_A.
stop_conditions: Engine exits non-zero — capture stderr verbatim, surface to user; do not proceed.
JSON missing any of the 7 top-level keys — schema mismatch; check engine version.
metadata.engine_version != system_anchors.engine_canon.version — STOP. Schema mismatch risk.

phase_4_choose_output_suite.goal: Pick which atlas / spectrum / projector pages make sense for this data.

decision_rules.condition: user has multiple datasets to compare AND they share carriers

skip_rules: Skip ternary-triplet plates (in stage2) when D < 3.
Skip Stage 4 cross-dataset comparisons unless user provides 2+ datasets.

phase_5_render_pipeline.goal: Generate the chosen output suite using the canonical orchestrator.
actions: If running a single experiment: invoke each module from HCI-CNT/mission_command/modules.py with the engine JSON as input.
If running a project of multiple experiments: write a temporary master_control.json project block and call: python3 HCI-CNT/mission_command/mission_command.py --project <project_name>
Capture file paths of all generated artefacts (PDFs, JSON, HTML) into the output manifest.

phase_6_self_verify.goal: Prove the result is reproducible and schema-clean. This is the determinism gate at the AI-orchestration layer.

checks.name: schema_validation
checks.pass_if: exit code 0 and 'schema 2.1.0 OK' on stdout

checks.name: engine_re_run_determinism
checks.command: Re-run the engine with the same CLI; compare diagnostics.content_sha256.

checks.name: corpus_match_when_applicable
checks.check: If this experiment id exists in HCI-CNT/experiments/INDEX.json, diagnostics.content_sha256 must match INDEX[id].content_sha256.
checks.if_mismatch: STOP. Either the engine version drifted or the input changed. Surface both SHAs to the user with line-by-line diff of input CSVs.

stop_conditions: Any check fails — DO NOT SHIP. Write the failure into the JOURNAL with full reproduction steps and surface to the user.

phase_7_present_and_journal.goal: Hand back to the user with a complete audit trail.
outputs: <name>_JOURNAL.md — auto-written audit-trail per the standard JOURNAL template; see HCI-CNT/experiments/<id>/JOURNAL.md for examples
<name>_<adapter>.py + <name>_disclosure.json — IF a new adapter was generated
Stage 1 + (Stage 2 + …) PDFs — the chosen output suite
<name>_pipeline_manifest.json — file list, hashes, engine signature, AI-build provenance
journal_template_fields: Headline results table (curvature/energy depth, IR class, amplitude, period, M² residual)
Auto-generated Conclusion paragraph (reuse the template in mission_command.modules._auto_conclusion)
AI build provenance block — which CCTT version, which AI model, which prompt elicited the run, what gates passed

must_do: Read the three handbook volumes before generating a new adapter.
Echo the proposed (T, D, ordering, carriers) to the user and wait for confirmation before phase 3.
Hash-check at every gate and report mismatches verbatim.
Write the JOURNAL.md with every run.
Disclose all transformations in the adapter source (provenance, dropped rows, imputation parameters).
must_not_do: Modify the canonical engine (cnt.py / cnt.R) — schema and signature are locked.
Modify the determinism gate corpus (HCI-CNT/experiments/INDEX.json) without explicit user authorisation.
Push to git or modify the canonical local repo — Cowork mirror only; see HS_MACHINE_MANIFEST.json -> fault_tolerance_dual_folder_method.
Skip the user-confirmation gate at the end of phase 2.
Ship a result whose phase-6 checks did not all pass.
Invent carrier names or column meanings — when ambiguous, ASK.
ai_responsibilities_and_boundaries.model_agnostic: This instruction is portable across AI assistants. Nothing in it is specific to Claude. ChatGPT, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, an in-house agent — any AI that can read files, run shell commands, and write JSON can follow CCTT.

user_facing_contract.what_the_user_provides: A compositional dataset (CSV/XLSX/TSV/JSON) plus, ideally, a one-sentence description of what it is.
what_the_user_gets_back: A Stage 1 page (always) and the additional Stage 2/3/4 + spectrum + projector pages that fit the data shape
A disclosed pre-parser adapter (if a new one was needed)
A JOURNAL.md audit trail with full provenance
A pipeline manifest listing every output file with SHA-256
what_the_user_does_NOT_need_to_know: How the determinism gate works internally
what_the_user_DOES_need_to_confirm: Which columns are carriers vs labels
Whether the labels are temporal or categorical
The units of the carrier values (and whether different carriers share units)
Whether zeros are 'true zero' or 'below detection limit' (changes the imputation choice)
